data.one_liner: Widget to trigger callbacks on horizontal swipe gestures.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Swipeable widget that detects horizontal drags or flings on its child. It can call different callbacks, show different backgrounds, and optionally confirm the swipe before executing the action.
use_when: You need a simple swipe‑to‑action UI like dismissing list items
You want different actions for left‑to‑right and right‑to‑left swipes
You need a confirmation step before the action is performed
avoid_when: You need complex gesture choreography or multi‑direction gestures
You need a full‑featured swipe‑list library with built‑in animations
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Supports multiple pointer kinds (touch, mouse, stylus)
Allows custom backgrounds per swipe direction
weaknesses: Limited built‑in animations or visual feedback
No support for vertical or multi‑direction gestures
